## Summary

```{r summary}
files <- list.files(pattern = "^CONC_Exp_.*\\.csv$")
stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

summarise_run <- function(f) {
  d  <- read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE)
  tibble(
    Exp_ID    = gsub("^CONC_Exp_|\\.csv$", "", f),
    C0        = d$DIOXANE[1],
    C_final   = tail(d$DIOXANE, 1),
    Deg_pct   = round((1 - tail(d$DIOXANE, 1) / d$DIOXANE[1]) * 100, 2),
    LRV       = round(tail(d$LRV, 1), 3),
    Fluence   = round(tail(d$Fluence_mJ_cm2, 1)),
    I_ratio   = round(tail(d$I_ratio, 1), 4),
    k_H2O2_0  = d$k_photo_H2O2[1],
    k_H2O2_f  = tail(d$k_photo_H2O2, 1)
  )
}

summary_df <- map_dfr(files, summarise_run)
write.csv(summary_df, "Master_Degradation_Summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(summary_df)
```

## Trajectories

```{r plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
runs <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  d <- read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE)
  names(d)[1] <- "Time"
  d$Exp_ID <- gsub("^CONC_Exp_|\\.csv$", "", f)
  d
})

ggplot(runs, aes(Fluence_mJ_cm2, LRV, colour = Exp_ID)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "UV fluence (mJ/cm2)", y = "LRV (1,4-dioxane)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(runs, aes(Time, `HCO3-`, colour = Exp_ID)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Carbonate buffer (must stay ~flat)",
       x = "Time (s)", y = "[HCO3-] (M)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Target vs predicted LRV

Fill the `Target_LRV` column in `kintecus_experimental_batch.xlsx` to turn this
section on. Target (observed) LRV is on the y-axis and predicted LRV on the
x-axis, following Piñeiro et al. (2008, *Ecol. Model.* 216:316–322). Each
panel fits target = m·predicted through the origin, so m = 1 is a perfect
match, m < 1 means the model overpredicts and m > 1 means it underpredicts.
The R² shown is the standard one, 1 − SS_res / SS_tot, with SS_tot taken about
the mean of the target LRV. The no-intercept R² that `lm()` reports is
inflated, so it isn't used here. RMSE is the root-mean-square difference
between predicted and target LRV, i.e. the scatter about the dashed 1:1 line,
in LRV units. The figure is also saved to `figures/LRV_target_vs_predicted.png`.

```{r lrv-target, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.2}
# Exp_ID prefix -> water sample type
water_types <- c(MW = "M1W", OC = "OCWD")

batch <- readxl::read_excel("kintecus_experimental_batch.xlsx")
if (!"Target_LRV" %in% names(batch)) batch$Target_LRV <- NA_real_

lrv <- summary_df |>
  select(Exp_ID, Predicted_LRV = LRV) |>
  inner_join(batch |> transmute(Exp_ID, Target_LRV = as.numeric(Target_LRV)),
             by = "Exp_ID") |>
  mutate(Water = unname(water_types[sub("_.*$", "", Exp_ID)])) |>
  filter(!is.na(Water), !grepl("test", Exp_ID, ignore.case = TRUE),
         is.finite(Target_LRV), is.finite(Predicted_LRV))

if (nrow(lrv) < 2) {
  cat("No Target_LRV values in the workbook yet -- plot skipped.\n")
} else {
  panels <- bind_rows(mutate(lrv, Group = "All experiments"),
                      mutate(lrv, Group = Water)) |>
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, c("All experiments", unname(water_types))))

  fit_one <- function(d) {
    m    <- unname(coef(lm(Target_LRV ~ 0 + Predicted_LRV, data = d)))
    res  <- d$Target_LRV - m * d$Predicted_LRV
    r2   <- 1 - sum(res^2) / sum((d$Target_LRV - mean(d$Target_LRV))^2)
    rmse <- sqrt(mean((d$Predicted_LRV - d$Target_LRV)^2))
    tibble(n = nrow(d), slope_m = m, R2 = r2, RMSE = rmse)
  }
  fits <- panels |> group_by(Group) |> filter(n() >= 2) |>
    group_modify(~ fit_one(.x)) |> ungroup() |>
    mutate(label = sprintf("y = %.3f x\nR² = %.3f\nRMSE = %.3f\nn = %d",
                           slope_m, R2, RMSE, n))

  lim <- c(0, max(c(panels$Target_LRV, panels$Predicted_LRV), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)

  p_lrv <- ggplot(panels, aes(Predicted_LRV, Target_LRV)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_abline(data = fits, aes(slope = slope_m, intercept = 0),
                colour = "#1f5fa8", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Water), size = 2.4) +
    geom_label(data = fits, aes(x = lim[2] * 0.02, y = lim[2], label = label),
               hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.4, linewidth = 0,
               fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, lineheight = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ Group, nrow = 1) +
    coord_equal(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(M1W = "#d1495b", OCWD = "#00798c")) +
    labs(x = "Predicted 1,4-dioxane LRV", y = "Target 1,4-dioxane LRV",
         colour = "Water") +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p_lrv)

  dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
  ggsave("figures/LRV_target_vs_predicted.png", p_lrv,
         width = 11, height = 4.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  knitr::kable(select(fits, -label), digits = 3,
               col.names = c("Group", "n", "Slope m (target = m·predicted)", "R²", "RMSE (LRV)"))
}
```

## Compare against the target model

Drop `target_model.xlsx` beside this file to enable this section.

```{r compare, eval=file.exists("target_model.xlsx")}
library(readxl)
tgt <- read_excel("target_model.xlsx", sheet = 1) |>
  slice(-1) |>                                   # units row
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) |>
  rename(Time = Chemicals)

# target name -> our name
map <- c("1,4-dioxane" = "DIOXANE", "H2O2" = "H2O2", "NH2Cl" = "NH2Cl",
         "NHCl2" = "NHCl2", "HCO3-" = "HCO3-", "H2CO3" = "H2CO3",
         "●OH" = "HO*", "Cl-" = "Cl-", "TOC" = "TOC")

one <- runs |> filter(Exp_ID == first(Exp_ID))
at  <- function(d, tc, vc, t) approx(d[[tc]], d[[vc]], t, rule = 2)$y

cmp <- expand.grid(t = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 30), sp = names(map),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  mutate(target = mapply(function(s, tt) at(tgt, "Time", s, tt), sp, t),
         ours   = mapply(function(s, tt) at(one, "Time", map[[s]], tt), sp, t),
         ratio  = round(ours / target, 3))
knitr::kable(cmp, digits = 8)
```
